Reasoning on the finding: invoice 324 is paid (P) and was entered first (journal 1524 precedes 2468), so it is kept. Invoice 802 (journal 2468) is the duplicate and must be voided, with its journal fully reversed.

The journal 2468 lines are: 5500 DR 7512.14, 5200 DR 9767.75, 2000 CR 17279.89. The reversal swaps each side: 5500 CR 7512.14, 5200 CR 9767.75, 2000 DR 17279.89. Totals balance (DR 17279.89 = CR 17279.89).

The correction must post to an open period. Journal 2468 is in PRD_ID 5, which is closed, so the reversal goes to open period 11 (20241101–20241130), the earliest open period. The reversal must use active accounts, and 5500, 5200 and 2000 are all active.

Invoice 802 is set to V with a single status change.
